vulnerability.name: USN-5224-2
vulnerability.description: USN-5224-1 fixed several vulnerabilities in Ghostscript. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 16.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:   It was discovered that Ghostscript incorrectly handled certain PostScript  files. If a user or automated system were tricked into processing a  specially crafted file, a remote attacker could possibly use this issue to  cause Ghostscript to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly  execute arbitrary code.

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in Ghostscript. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
